$comment: Suite model-card/v1 (v6.3 M2b): the pairings of contracts/semantics/model_pairings.json (O03), parameters shared within one model, observation use within a joint evaluation (R-AUX) and cross-model sharing. Not supported: shapes, multivariate constraints, joint evaluations of several cards (undefined cross-model merges), full HistFactory. Pre-release 1.1.0-dev.1 (release R2): the 1.0.0 rules and generator for check-context 1.1.0; rule fixes move to later pre-releases. check-report refuses a pre-release suite.
not_supported: joint evaluations of several model cards (no combiner contract)
